meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 Chat SDK 桥接 Linear,自动参与 issue 评论线程:每个评论都触发它回复,无需 @提及;每个 issue 的评论线程是一个独立对话。
howto.when: 当某已接入团队的 Linear issue 出现新评论时触发;每个评论都会触发,无需 @提及。新 webhook 可能有 1–5 分钟延迟。

say.text: 把 Linear 接入 agent,自动回复所有 issue 评论
say.note: 这么做会触发配置流程,按提示填 OAuth 和团队信息。

say.text: 用个人 API 密钥配置 Linear 集成
say.note: 这会走个人身份,你自己的评论会被过滤。

say.text: 查看 Linear 通道的接线状态

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude bridges Linear via the Chat SDK and automatically joins issue comment threads: every comment triggers a reply, no @-mention needed; each issue's comment thread becomes a separate conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new comment appears on a Linear issue in an onboarded team; every comment triggers it, no @-mention needed. New webhooks may lag 1–5 minutes.

say_en.text: Connect Linear to the agent and auto-reply to all issue comments
say_en.note: This triggers the setup flow; follow prompts for OAuth and team info.

say_en.text: Set up Linear integration with a personal API key
say_en.note: This uses your identity; your own comments get filtered.

say_en.text: Check the Linear channel wiring status
